Great Service on an order for delivery from Hong Kong!
Oct 2025 • Solo
I wanted to order something for my team in Vietnam to celebrate them moving into a new office in Ho Chi Minh City. I am in Hong Kong and this is not an easy to do remotely in Vietnam. Annam Gourmet responded to my email inquiry (email address from their website) within 30-40mins and quickly put me in touch with one of their Annam Gourmet store team in D1 over WhatsApp, Nam Phúóng! Nam Phúóng was patient, helpful when what I wanted was out of stock and shared pics with me of what they could deliver in just under 24hours and ultimately helped me arrange everything. Super impressed with the customer service and I have a very happy team in Vietnam. Moved into a new office today and they have a cake and macaroons from Annam Gourmet to celebrate!

Nov 2024 • Family

I've had enough of this and will not go back.

The place to go for unique Vietnamese products
Nov 2019 • Solo
If you love food and buying ingredients to take home then this is the place. A great range of local and imported goods including local chocolates, peppers from Phu Quoc, fish sauces, jams, local turmeric - everything. Even Kampot pepper from Cambodia. The prices are also reasonable compared to gift shops. Definitely worth a visit plus they have a great bakery and cafe upstairs. This is one for the foodies.

Excellent choices & value for money
Aug 2019
I recently ate at this Hai Ba Trung cafe for lunch and the selection of food was excellent. Wide variety of starters & salads to choose from, hot soup with bread, delicious main courses with accompanying vegetables, potatoes and selection of sauces and cake or fruit for dessert. All for only VND250K 
To make this even better a glass of house wine, red or white, costs only VND50K
Annam Gourmet have at least 3 such outlets all offering the same kind of buffet lunch for their patrons.
